narrative.headline: Plan expressway journeys with source toll estimates, directional rest stops and official advisories.
narrative.value_prop: Resolve interchanges and compare source route alternatives with explicit vehicle and JST schedule assumptions. Find directional SA/PA facilities and keep dated notices distinct from current road status.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public read-only English and Japanese pages; no account, key or browser runtime is required.

quickstart.comment: Resolve an exact English interchange name.
Compare source alternatives with explicit JST assumptions.
Find directional stops on Tohoku Expressway.

troubleshoots.symptom: English SA/PA name search returns no results
troubleshoots.fix: Use sapa list --road 1040 and filter locally with --query HASUDA.
Use --at YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in JST with minutes00,10,20,30,40 or50.

troubleshoots.symptom: ETC quote differs from a later drive
troubleshoots.fix: Re-run route with your vehicle and planned time; quoted discounts depend on actual eligibility and travel.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Drive Plaza expressway route estimates, IC resolution, directional SA/PA facilities and official advisory links. Inspect source assumptions before comparing prices or travel times.
anti_triggers: Comprehensive current traffic or active-closure inventory
Bookings, pass purchases or account changes
